title: Owner reactions to black and white color choices
summary: Feedback centers on owner reactions to Carbon Black, Smoke White, and Mineral White, with praise for appearance and several undetermined comments that only mention color preference or color matching without a clear evaluative outcome.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise Carbon Black, Smoke White, and Mineral White for their attractive look, distinctive shade, or suitability to local conditions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention color preference, washing burden, or a mismatched black versus carbon black part, but the examples do not consistently state a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Many examples are brief color mentions or preferences without enough context to determine a clear sentiment.
This topic mixes exterior paint colors with at least one interior color mention about Smoke White seats.
The sampled fragments are stratified examples and are not representative estimates for the full owner population.
